'''Vincent Olatunji''' is a [[Nigerians|Nigerian]] policy innovator, public sector analyst,<ref>{{Cite news |last=Hassan |first=Bashir |date=2022-04-04 |title=Meet Vincent Olatunji: Nigeria's 'Data Security Officer (DSO)' |url=https://businessday.ng/technology/article/meet-vincent-olatunji-nigerias-data-security-officer-dso/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2025-04-20 |newspaper=[[BusinessDay (Nigeria)|BusinessDay]]|language=}}</ref> and the National Commissioner of the [[Nigeria Data Protection Commission]] (NDPC).<ref>{{Cite news |last=Ozibo |first=Rosalia |date=29 January 2025 |title=Nigeria's data privacy ecosystem can drive a trillion-dollar economy – NDPC |url=https://nairametrics.com/2025/01/29/nigerias-data-privacy-ecosystem-can-drive-a-trillion-dollar-economy-ndpc/ |access-date=31 March 2025 |work=Nairametrics}}</ref> He was previously the acting director general of the [[National Information Technology Development Agency]] (NITDA)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Vincent O. Olatunji, PhD – NITDA |url=https://nitda.gov.ng/vincent-o-olatunji-phd/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250211230337/https://nitda.gov.ng/vincent-o-olatunji-phd/ |archive-date=2025-02-11 |access-date=2025-03-31 |website=nitda.gov.ng |language=en-US |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Omotayo |first=Boluwatife |date=2025-01-22 |title=Nigeria's digital economy needs strong privacy laws — NDPC boss |url=https://businessday.ng/technology/article/nigerias-digital-economy-needs-strong-privacy-laws-ndpc-boss/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2025-03-31 |newspaper=[[BusinessDay (Nigeria)|BusinessDay]]|language=en-US}}</ref> and also served as chairman of Nigeria Data Protection Commission Implementation Committee.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr. Olatunji Joins Global Data Protection Panel – Nigeria Data Protection Commission |url=https://ndpc.gov.ng/2025/03/06/dr-olatunji-joins-global-data-protection-panel/#:~:text=The%20National%20Commissioner%20and%20CEO,in%20Washington,%20D.C.,%20USA. |access-date=2025-04-20 |website=ndpc.gov.ng}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
He was born in [[Ekiti State|Ekiti state]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Bashir |first=Hassan |date=2022-04-04 |title=Meet Vincent Olatunji: Nigeria's 'Data Security Officer (DSO)' |url=https://businessday.ng/technology/article/meet-vincent-olatunji-nigerias-data-security-officer-dso/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2025-04-20 |newspaper=[[BusinessDay (Nigeria)|BusinessDay]]|language=en-US}}</ref> He attended the [[University of Lagos]] in 1996 where he obtained a diploma in computer science. He holds a doctorate degree (PhD) in Geography and Planning from University of Lagos and an Advanced Diploma in Computer Science.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |last=Hassan |first=Bashir Ibrahim |date=2022-04-04 |title=Meet Vincent Olatunji: Nigeria's 'Data Security Officer (DSO)' |url=https://businessday.ng/technology/article/meet-vincent-olatunji-nigerias-data-security-officer-dso/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2025-03-31 |newspaper=[[BusinessDay (Nigeria)|BusinessDay]]|language=en-US}}</ref> He is a certified Public Private Partnership Specialist (IP3 Specialist) and Certified Data Protection Officer.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Chukwudiebere |first=Mercy |date=2023-06-13 |title=Nigeria's Vincent Olatunji Appointed To Forbes Technology Council |url=https://von.gov.ng/nigerias-vincent-olatunji-appointed-to-forbes-technology-council/ |access-date=2025-04-20 |newspaper=[[Voice of Nigeria]]|language=en-US}}</ref>

== Career ==

After his graduation from the university, he joined the [[Federal Civil Service Commission (Nigeria)|Federal Civil Service]] in Nigeria as a research officer under the Federal Urban Mass Transit Agency.<ref>{{Cite news |last= |date=2022-04-04 |title=Meet Vincent Olatunji: Nigeria's 'Data Security Officer (DSO)' |url=https://businessday.ng/technology/article/meet-vincent-olatunji-nigerias-data-security-officer-dso/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2025-04-20 |newspaper=[[BusinessDay (Nigeria)|BusinessDay]]|language=en-US}}</ref> He joined [[National Information Technology Development Agency]] (NITDA) in 2002 in the planning research and statistics department. He became NITDA Director in 2014 and Acting Director General in 2016.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-02-10 |title=Vincent Olatunji, The Trusted Man to Lead The Nigeria Data Protection Bureau – Digital Economy |url=https://digitaleconomymag.com/vincent-olatunji-the-trusted-man-to-lead-the-nigerian-data-protection-bureau/ |access-date=2025-04-20 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=ITEdgeNews |date=2023-06-16 |title=EXCLUSIVE: Vincent Olatunji becomes statutory National Commissioner of Nigeria Data Protection Commission |url=https://www.itedgenews.africa/exclusive-vincent-olatunji-becomes-statutory-national-commissioner-of-nigeria-data-protection-commission/ |access-date=2025-04-20 |website=ITEdgeNews |language=en-US}}</ref> He also worked as Director of eGovernment and Regulations at NITDA.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Writer |first=Guest |date=2022-05-31 |title=Olatunji: Nigeria's data security officer |url=https://www.thecable.ng/olatunji-nigerias-data-security-officer/ |access-date=2025-04-20 |newspaper=[[TheCable]]|language=en-US}}</ref> He was appointed the national commissioner of the Nigeria Data Protection Agency (NDPC) in 2022 by President [[Muhammadu Buhari]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Online |first=The Eagle |date=2022-02-07 |title=Ekiti Council commends Buhari over Vincent Olatunji's appointment {{!}} |url=https://theeagleonline.com.ng/ekiti-council-commends-buhari-over-vincent-olatunjis-appointment/ |access-date=2025-03-31 |website=The Eagle Online |language=en-US}}</ref> In October 2023, he was re-appointed by President [[Bola Tinubu]].<ref>{{Cite news |title=President Tinubu appoints five CEOs for Communication, Digital Economy agencies |url=https://pmnewsnigeria.com/2023/10/11/president-tinubu-appoints-five-ceos-for-communication-digital-economy-agencies/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2025-03-31 |language=en-US|newspaper=[[P.M. News]]}}</ref> He was appointed to the Forbes Technology Council in 2023.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Odoh |first=Innocent |date=2023-06-13 |title=NDPB Boss, Olatunji, Appointed Into Forbes Technology Council |url=https://leadership.ng/ndpb-boss-olatunji-appointed-into-forbes-technology-council/ |access-date=2025-04-20 |language=en-US|newspaper=[[Leadership (newspaper)|Leadership]]}}</ref>
